d:
Desh men in dinon sanvidhan ko lekar siyasat chal rahi hai.ek taraph rahul gandhi sanvidhan raksha ko abhiyan bana chuke hain to dusri taraph bhartiy janta parti men sanvidhan gaurav ko hathiyar banaya hai. bhajpa ke rashtriy adhyaksh nitin navin ne kangres parti ko aaeena dikhane ki koshish ki hai.
